title: Charts
description: GPU-accelerated charts that stay at 60 fps with millions of points, plus Canvas2D shape charts: trends, comparisons, statistics, parts of a whole, hierarchies and flows, finance and trading, and 3D. Chart mixes line, area, bar, scatter, candlestick and heatmap series; every other component is a preset for one chart type. Start with the galleries below: a live thumbnail of every chart type, each linking to its page.

rendering.title: How it renders
rendering.text: The data layer is drawn with WebGPU, falling back to WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D (renderer="auto"); the root element gets data-renderer once ready. A chart stacks four layers:
rendering.background: Canvas2D background: grid, axes and annotation areas
rendering.data: GPU data layer: lines, areas, bars and dots
rendering.labels: Canvas2D overlay: tick labels, point labels, highlight
rendering.dom: DOM: tooltip and legend (selectable, accessible text)

largeData.title: Large data
largeData.text: Pass large series as columns of typed arrays ({ x: Float64Array, y: Float64Array }): no per-point objects are created. When x is sorted, hit testing is a binary search and only the visible range is drawn, so a 1M-point line or scatter stays at 60 fps on WebGPU, WebGL2 and WebGL.

interaction.title: Interaction and keyboard
interaction.pointer: Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel or a trackpad pinch zooms (a plain wheel scrolls the page), drag pans when zoomed and double-click resets.
interaction.keyboard: Focus the chart: ← / → move the highlighted point (announced to screen readers), + / - zoom, 0 resets and Esc clears.

theming.title: Theming and the engine
theming.text: Colors come from the Minerva CSS variables: --chart-series-1..8 when defined, else the theme colors (--primary-color, --success-color...). Theme switches are picked up automatically.
theming.core: minerva-design/charts/core is the same engine without React: createChart(container, options) works in any framework.

families.title: Chart families
families.text: Every chart type is shown below as a live thumbnail, grouped in five galleries; each caption links to the page of the chart:
families.basic: Basic 2D: <line>line</line>, <area>area</area>, <rangeArea>range area</rangeArea>, <bar>bar</bar>, <horizontalBar>horizontal bar</horizontalBar>, <mixed>combination / dual axis</mixed>, <scatter>scatter</scatter>, <bubble>bubble</bubble> charts and <sparkline>sparklines</sparkline>.
families.statistics: Statistics, KPIs and planning: <histogram>histogram</histogram>, <boxplot>box plot</boxplot>, <waterfall>waterfall</waterfall>, <heatmap>heatmap</heatmap>, <calendar>calendar heatmap</calendar>, <gauge>gauge</gauge>, <bullet>bullet</bullet>, <radialBar>radial bar</radialBar> and <gantt>Gantt</gantt> charts.
families.relations: Parts, relations and hierarchies: <pie>pie and donut</pie>, <radar>radar</radar>, <funnel>funnel</funnel>, <quadrant>quadrant</quadrant>, <treemap>treemap</treemap>, <sunburst>sunburst</sunburst> and <sankey>Sankey</sankey> charts.
families.finance: Finance and trading: <candlestick>candlesticks</candlestick>, <trading>trading chart</trading>, <indicators>technical indicators</indicators>, <depth>depth chart</depth>, <orderBook>order book</orderBook>, <orderBookHeatmap>order book heatmap</orderBookHeatmap> and <timeSales>time & sales</timeSales>.
families.threeD: 3D: <scatter>3D scatter and 3D line</scatter>, <surface>3D surface</surface> and <bar>3D bar</bar> charts.
families.lazy: The thumbnails are mounted only while they are near the viewport (IntersectionObserver): the page stays fast and never holds more GPU contexts than the browser allows. The order book widgets stream a simulated market and pause off screen.
families.fallback: The GPU charts pick their backend in four tiers, WebGPU → WebGL2 → WebGL → Canvas2D, so they render in every browser and survive a GPU loss; see the <engine>chart engine</engine> and <performance>performance</performance> pages.

gallery.title: Gallery: basic 2D charts
gallery.description: Line, stacked area, monthly temperature range, bars with value labels, a horizontal ranking, revenue bars with a growth line on a second axis, scatter, campaign bubbles sized by reach and KPI sparklines. Each caption links to the chart's page; hover the charts for their tooltips.

gallery-statistics.title: Gallery: statistics, KPIs and planning
gallery-statistics.description: A latency histogram, box plots per service, a revenue bridge waterfall, a weekly load heatmap, a commit calendar, a gauge with bands, bullet KPIs against their targets, progress rings and a release Gantt chart.

gallery-relations.title: Gallery: parts, relations and hierarchies
gallery-relations.description: Browser shares in a pie, users per plan in a donut with the total, a vendor radar, a sign-up funnel, a priority quadrant, a budget treemap, a headcount sunburst and a Sankey diagram from traffic sources to sign-ups.

gallery-finance.title: Gallery: finance and trading
gallery-finance.description: Candlesticks, the trading chart with a moving average and volume, Bollinger bands with RSI, and the order book widgets (depth chart, price ladder, liquidity heatmap and time & sales) streaming a simulated market. They mount when scrolled into view; Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel zooms.

gallery-3d.title: Gallery: 3D charts
gallery-3d.description: Clusters in a slowly rotating 3D scatter, a spiral trajectory, a ripple surface and sales per region and quarter as 3D bars. Drag to rotate; they render only while visible.

mixed.description: Each series sets its own type: bars and a line share the category axis, with a legend at the bottom.

renderers.title: Renderers
renderers.description: Force a backend with renderer; onRendererChange reports the one actually used (unsupported backends fall back).

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: A dashed reference line, a horizontal band (rect with only y0 / y1) and an x range, each with a label.

dashboard.title: Analytics dashboard
dashboard.description: Several charts working together on 30 days of a web shop: KPI cards with sparklines, stacked areas of new and returning visitors, a donut of devices with the total in the hole and the top pages as labelled bars.

palette.title: Palettes
palette.description: palette replaces the series colors of any chart, GPU or shape: the theme colors, a colorblind-safe set (Okabe-Ito), a sequential blue ramp or warm tones. Leave it unset to follow --chart-series-1..8.

ChartProps.series: Data series; each sets its own type
ChartProps.stackMode: normal stacks the values; percent scales every stack to 100% at each x
ChartProps.yAxis2: Right value axis of the series with yAxis: "right"; its range is aligned on the left ticks (vertical charts)
ChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" puts the x axis (categories) down the left side and the values along the bottom

ChartCommonProps.height: Height of the chart, legend included; numbers are pixels
ChartCommonProps.width: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels
ChartCommonProps.renderer: Backend of the data layer: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D
ChartCommonProps.legend: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name
ChartCommonProps.crosshair: Vertical guide line following the pointer
ChartCommonProps.interaction: Zoom, pan, double-click reset and keyboard; false makes the chart static
ChartCommonProps.padding: Space around the plot area, in pixels
ChartCommonProps.palette: Series colors (defaults to --chart-series-1..8, then the theme colors)
ChartCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) points change
ChartCommonProps.onPointClick: Called when a point or bar is clicked
ChartCommonProps.onPlotClick: Called with the data coordinates when the plot area is clicked where there is no point
ChartCommonProps.renderTooltip: React content of the tooltip; replaces the default content (the box, position and pointer handling are kept)
ChartCommonProps.onZoom: Called when the user zooms or pans
ChartCommonProps.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once ready, and after a GPU fallback
ChartCommonProps.className: Additional class name of the root element
ChartCommonProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
ChartCommonProps.locale: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units, separators, month and weekday names); the page language by default
ChartCommonProps.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts of the locale (ChartLabels)
ChartCommonProps.testID: Test identifier of the root view (React Native)

ChartHandle.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready
ChartHandle.getController: DOM-free controller of the chart (React Native)
ChartHandle.getPlotRect: Plot area in pixels of the chart view

ChartSeries.name: Name shown in the legend and the tooltip
ChartSeries.type: How the series is drawn: line, area, bar, scatter, candlestick or heatmap
ChartSeries.data: Y values, [x, y] tuples, objects or columns
ChartSeries.color: Series color (any CSS color, var() included)
ChartSeries.stack: Series with the same stack id are stacked (bars, lines and areas; see stackMode for 100% stacks)
ChartSeries.hidden: Hides the series (it stays in the legend)
ChartSeries.showLabels: Draws the label of each point next to it (scatter) or the value above each bar (bar)
ChartSeries.curve: Shape of the line between the points: linear, smooth (monotone, never overshoots the data) or step (line / area)
ChartSeries.upColor: Candlestick: color of the rising candles (close ≥ open); --success-color by default
ChartSeries.downColor: Candlestick: color of the falling candles; --danger-color by default
ChartSeries.colorScale: Heatmap: colors from the lowest to the highest value (two or more)
ChartSeries.valueRange: Heatmap: values mapped to the ends of colorScale; the data range by default
ChartSeries.radius: Bar / heatmap: corner radius in pixels (bars 3, cells 2)
ChartSeries.format: Formats the values of this series in the tooltip (the y axis format by default)
ChartSeries.yAxis: Value axis of the series: "right" plots it against yAxis2 (dual axis charts, vertical orientation)
ChartSeries.barWidth: Bars and box plots: share of a category taken by the bars, 0-1 (1 makes them touch, e.g. histograms)
ChartSeries.valueName: Scatter: name of the value of the points in the tooltip (bubble charts)

ChartPointDatum.x: X value (number, Date or category); the index when omitted
ChartPointDatum.y: Y value; null leaves a gap. Candlestick: the close; heatmap: the row
ChartPointDatum.color: Color of the dot or bar (scatter, bar)
ChartPointDatum.label: Text next to the dot and in the tooltip
ChartPointDatum.value: Heatmap: value of the cell, mapped to colorScale
ChartPointDatum.y0: Start of a floating bar (waterfall steps, Gantt tasks) or lower edge of a range area; dates are timestamps
ChartPointDatum.q1: Box plot: first quartile (bottom of the box; y is the median)
ChartPointDatum.q3: Box plot: third quartile (top of the box)
ChartPointDatum.outliers: Box plot: values beyond the whiskers, drawn as dots

ChartColumnData.x: X values; the index when omitted
ChartColumnData.y: Y values; NaN / null leave a gap (candlestick: the closes; heatmap: the rows)
ChartColumnData.y0: Starts of floating bars / lower edges of range areas (NaN / null: from zero)

ChartAxisOptions.type: Scale: linear, time or category (detected from the data)
ChartAxisOptions.min: Lower bound; computed from the data when omitted
ChartAxisOptions.max: Upper bound; computed from the data when omitted
ChartAxisOptions.title: Axis title
ChartAxisOptions.categories: Category names; collected from the data when omitted
ChartAxisOptions.format: Formats a tick or tooltip value
ChartAxisOptions.grid: Draws grid lines at the ticks
ChartAxisOptions.visible: Shows the axis line, ticks and labels
ChartAxisOptions.zero: Keeps zero inside the automatic range (always on for bars)
ChartAxisOptions.reverse: Reverses the direction of the axis
ChartAxisOptions.nice: Rounds the automatic range to tick values
ChartAxisOptions.timeZone: Calendar of a time axis: ticks and tooltips in local time or in UTC ("local" | "utc")

ChartRectAnnotation.x0: Left bound; the plot edge when omitted
ChartRectAnnotation.x1: Right bound; the plot edge when omitted
ChartRectAnnotation.y0: Bottom bound; the plot edge when omitted
ChartRectAnnotation.y1: Top bound; the plot edge when omitted
ChartRectAnnotation.label: Text drawn inside the area

ChartLineAnnotation.axis: Axis of the value: x (vertical line) or y (horizontal line)
ChartLineAnnotation.value: Position of the line, in data units
ChartLineAnnotation.label: Text drawn at the end of the line

ChartTextAnnotation.anchor: Side of the text that touches the position (center, top, bottom, left, right); the text stays inside the plot
ChartTextAnnotation.color: Text color (defaults to the secondary text color)

ChartInteractionOptions.zoom: Axes that zoom and pan (x, y, xy); true picks them from the series types
ChartInteractionOptions.wheel: Wheel zoom only with Ctrl / ⌘ (modifier) or always
ChartInteractionOptions.keyboard: Arrows move the highlight, +/- zoom, 0 resets, Esc clears
ChartInteractionOptions.dragPoints: Lets the user drag scatter points (drag / drop events; the chart does not move them)

ChartTooltipOptions.mode: nearest shows the closest point, axis every series at the closest x
ChartTooltipOptions.render: Renders the tooltip content (a string is set as text)
ChartTooltipOptions.labels: Names of the rows of the default tooltip (box plot statistics, OHLC, bubble values), for translations

ChartLegendOptions.toggle: Clicking an item toggles its series

ChartPadding.right: Space right of the plot area
ChartPadding.left: Space left of the plot area

ChartHoverEvent.items: Points under the pointer (several in axis mode)
ChartHoverEvent.x: X value of the first item

ChartHoverItem.index: Index of the point in the series data
ChartHoverItem.y: Y value of the point (candlestick: the close)
ChartHoverItem.label: Label of the point, if any
ChartHoverItem.y0: Floating bars and range areas: the start (or lower edge); y is the end
ChartHoverItem.q1: Box plot: first quartile (y is the median, low / high the whiskers)

ChartPlotClickEvent.x: X data coordinate of the click
ChartPlotClickEvent.y: Y data coordinate of the click

mixed.title: Mixed series
mixed.description: Bars and a line share the category axis, drawn with plain Views; tap a bar or a point of the line.

mixed-series.title: Bars and a line
mixed-series.description: The engine options as one object: series of several types (here bars and a smooth line) on shared category axes.

events.title: Engine events
events.description: Hover and click a point: the engine events (hover, point click, zoom, renderer) reach the framework with the engine's payload.

props.options: Engine options (ChartOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: series, axes, legend, tooltip, annotations…); property only, replace the object to update the chart
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready

props.options: Engine options (ShapeChartOptions of minerva-design/charts/core, type included: pie, radar, gauge, funnel, treemap, sankey…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
